name.value: Old Towne Inne Chuckwagon Bar & Grill

description.value: Old Towne Inne is a Western-themed motel and restaurant in Boston Bar, set at the heart of the Fraser Canyon on the Trans-Canada Highway. The property offers four self-contained cabins with kitchen facilities and private bathrooms, plus three additional rooms above the restaurant, making it one of the only lodging options in this small canyon town. The attached Chuckwagon Bar & Grill is a well-reviewed local institution famed for its burgers, homemade soup, and over-21 burger varieties.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides clear evidence for several amenities: Free WiFi is explicitly listed as a service and confirmed on the Cabins & Rooms page ('WiFi is secured. Password is supplied at time of registration if requested.'); the on-site Chuckwagon Bar & Grill serves lunch, dinner, and drinks, confirming nearby evening food. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention secure bike storage, a bike procedure for staff, laundry, tools, or other bike-specific infrastructure, so those remain null. Contact details (phone, email) are confirmed identical between OSM and website.
concerns: Website internally inconsistent on cabin count: front page lists 'three self-contained cabins' plus a separate 'Jacuzzi suite', while the Cabins & Rooms subpage states 'four self-contained cabins'. OSM rooms=7 aligns with 4 cabins + 3 rooms.
Website content appears largely static since April 2017; currency of information uncertain.
EV charging station listed under parking but no mention of e-bike charging or cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate motel on a primary cycling corridor (Trans-Canada through the Fraser Canyon) with on-site food and WiFi, but neither secure bike storage nor a staff bike procedure could be confirmed from available evidence, which are required criteria for WWC accreditation. Direct follow-up with the property is needed.
